parsed.title: Route vocabulary mismatch
parsed.detail: The test asserts that the router's closed route set is `['replan', 'decision', 'fold', 'execute', 'plan-from-issue']`, but the sensor's `readSuggestions` logic in `scripts/workflow-status.mjs` (and the corresponding test in `scripts/workflow-status-sensor.test.mjs`) uses `/plan-fix/` and `/plan-feature/` as command prefixes, which are not in the router's declared `ROUTES` set.

parsed.title: Command mismatch in suggested routes
parsed.detail: The test asserts that a replan row results in a command `/plan-feature 90-alpha`, but the router's vocabulary (as tested in `scripts/normative-drift.test.mjs`) only contains `plan-from-issue`. The sensor is emitting a command that the router does not recognize as a valid route.

parsed.title: Inconsistent route matching
parsed.detail: The `PLAN_ROUTE` regex `replan[- ]in[- ]unit|owned by plan|plan owner|plan-owner` is used to identify replan rows, but the router's actual route name is `replan`. If a row's route is exactly `replan`, the regex matches, but the sensor's logic for `readSuggestions` uses `row.route` or `row.klass`. If `row.route` is `replan`, it works, but the sensor's `trigger` string includes `replan-in-unit`, which is a different token than the router's `replan`.
